verdi: The netted sum of electricity exports and imports (i.e. commercial schedules) shall be published for each bidding zone per market time unit with indicator whether the value represents import or export.
The day-ahead implicit net position consists of the sum of all commercial exchanges across all bidding zone borders from implicit day-ahead allocations.
